commands.name: StartRfcWfmImportCheck
steps: validate authenticated invocation and source family
inside short UoW perform command idempotency and create one durable LLD-01 job with bounded source-family/profile/manual-selection reference; no workbook bytes
audit check initiation and commit
worker executes discovery/security/parsing outside domain mutation transactions
rules: automatic invocation requires configured directory
manual selection may be outside directory but cannot bypass source validation
one source check never scans Communications or mutates RFC/WFM/Task state

commands.name: PublishStagedImportRun
steps: while run_state=validating, normalized rows/fields/findings may be appended in bounded transactions as unpublished technical staging; queries/proposals treat them as nonexistent source evidence
after parser reaches complete EOF, recompute exact child counts and logical fingerprint from the unpublished rows and classify replay/chronology against the current source-family checkpoint

if exact replay, delete unpublished findings/fields/rows through the guarded staging-cleanup path while the run is still validating, then atomically set fingerprint/count metadata and mark run noop with completed_at; create no SourceObservation/proposal/domain history
if newer-identical, likewise delete unpublished row evidence before publication, atomically set fingerprint/count metadata and transition run to noop_pending_checkpoint; create no proposals

if equal chronology/different content or older chronology, generate the same smallest-safe-scope reconciliation proposals from the complete source set, force ordinary acceptance closed by run_state=recovery_required, and atomically publish rows/findings/proposals as immutable recovery evidence
otherwise generate all reconciliation proposals from the complete staging set and atomically publish by transitioning run staged/waiting_review with exact counters/fingerprint/revision
only staged/waiting_review/recovery_required/noop_pending_checkpoint/noop runs are visible to review/history queries
rules: crash before publish cannot make partial run reviewable
failed/partial parse cannot advance checkpoint
SourceObservation immutability begins at publication, not during technical staging
recovery-required proposals are visible/readable but cannot be accepted without an exact current authorized recovery review
source omission produces no RFC/WFM disappearance proposals

commands.name: AcceptReconciliationProposal
steps: load pending proposal and exact published source/run/profile evidence
reject blocked proposal

when parent run is recovery_required recompute the current recovery review fingerprint from exact run/checkpoint/material proposal inputs and require the latest import_recovery_review for that fingerprint has decision=authorized; otherwise return IMPORT_RECOVERY_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED or IMPORT_RECOVERY_REVIEW_STALE
inside one short UoW recompute current authoritative base-state token via owning LLD readers and revalidate recovery authorization when applicable
on target token mismatch return IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE with no accepted disposition/domain mutation
enter one outer idempotent command envelope; the owning domain service receives the same UoW/command context and must not commit independently

invoke the exact LLD-02/03/05 mutation service selected by proposal_kind; wfm_provisional_eligibility invokes LLD-03 RFC lifecycle authority, and terminal RFC source projection uses LLD-03 terminal-epoch/cascade-proposal semantics
append accepted proposal disposition and required audit/result references in the same UoW
transition proposal accepted, refresh run counters, commit
rules: one acceptance never implicitly accepts sibling proposals
source acceptance never executes RFC terminal cascade or Objective regrouping
Beta 1.0 RFC/WFM mutation auto-accept policy is empty
recovery authorization permits review execution only; it never accepts proposals itself

commands.name: RejectReconciliationProposal
steps: revalidate exact pending proposal/fingerprint and any required recovery authorization for a recovery run
insert receipt
append rejected disposition and optional bounded equivalence decision
transition proposal rejected/update run counters
audit decision
commit
rules: no domain mutation
rejection does not erase valid published source presence
newer chronology alone does not force redisplay when material-input equivalence remains exact

commands.name: DeferReconciliationProposal
steps: revalidate pending proposal and any required recovery authorization for a recovery run
insert receipt
append deferred disposition/equivalence evidence
transition proposal deferred/update run counters
audit
commit
rules: defer mutates no domain authority
explicit reconsideration may create a fresh proposal bound to current state without rewriting old decision

commands.name: FinalizeImportRunReview
steps: inside UoW require run is staged/waiting_review or an authorized recovery_required run and has zero pending proposals
recompute exact proposal/disposition counters and verify no blocked unresolved scope is being hidden
for recovery_required revalidate the exact latest recovery authorization/review fingerprint and capture current checkpoint before finalization
insert receipt

derive final run state accepted when all target proposals accepted/no_change, rejected when all actionable proposals rejected/superseded, otherwise partially_accepted including mixes with rejected/deferred
ordinary new-source path advances source-family checkpoint to this explicitly processed source set when chronology is newer/currently absent

equal-chronology authorized correction replaces the checkpoint fingerprint/run at the same chronology after all proposal decisions are consistent; older-source recovery never decreases or replaces the higher checkpoint chronology
for recovery_required append one import_recovery_event bound to the exact authorization fingerprint/prior checkpoint and final decision set
record bounded review-finalization audit, set completed_at, increment revision and commit atomically
rules: checkpoint represents latest explicitly processed source observation set at its retained monotonic chronology, not proof every proposed domain mutation was accepted
RFC/WFM omission still has no lifecycle meaning
a deferred proposal remains historical decision evidence and may later be reconsidered independently
recovery finalization cannot occur under a stale or later-deferred/rejected recovery review

commands.name: RecordNewerIdenticalSourceCheck
steps: prove run state is noop_pending_checkpoint, unpublished per-row staging has been cleaned and no proposals exist
inside UoW revalidate candidate chronology is newer and logical fingerprint equals current checkpoint
insert receipt
advance checkpoint chronology/run/last_checked while preserving fingerprint
transition run noop/set completed_at/increment revision
audit bounded source-check recency
commit
commands.rule: creates no duplicate per-entity source observations, proposals or domain audit changes

commands.name: ResolveImportRecovery
steps: inside UoW recompute recovery review fingerprint from exact current run/checkpoint/material proposal inputs and require exact match
allocate next review_ordinal under the writer lock and insert command receipt before recovery-review row
for authorize_correction append import_recovery_review decision=authorized only; leave run recovery_required and proposals pending for normal per-proposal reviewed decisions
for defer append decision=deferred only; leave run/proposals unchanged and closed to acceptance until a later fresh authorization

for reject first require accepted_proposal_count=0; otherwise return IMPORT_RECOVERY_REJECT_AFTER_ACCEPTANCE, then append decision=rejected, supersede every still-pending proposal with recovery-origin disposition, set run rejected/completed with exact counters, leave checkpoint unchanged, audit and commit
no branch of this command performs RFC/WFM/Task domain mutation
rules: authorization is append-only review authority, not domain acceptance
latest exact-fingerprint recovery review controls the gate
a later defer/reject closes earlier authorization without deleting it
whole-run reject cannot undo already accepted proposal history
older-source checkpoint chronology never moves backward

worker_recovery: startup finds durable import jobs/runs left discovering/validating by prior process and classifies them interrupted through LLD-01 job recovery
an unpublished partial run is never treated as complete; deterministic restart either resumes from a verified parser checkpoint owned by the durable job or marks it failed and starts a new run

unpublished rows belonging to interrupted/failed validating runs never participate in replay/proposal/domain queries and may be removed by the guarded technical-staging cleanup; published rows are immutable operational source evidence and are never cleaned as staging
